title: Canonical Notification Pattern
purpose: Demonstrate a centralized Notifications class with one static method per notification type, using updateArgs for i18n and the public/private split for hidden information.
context: A Notifications class that centralizes all BGA framework notify calls. It exposes static methods for each game event. Card draws require a public notification (to announce the draw) and a private notification (to reveal the card only to the drawing player).
before: self::notifyAllPlayers('cardDrawn', clienttranslate('${player_name} draws a card'), ['player_id' => $playerId, 'i18n' => ['player_name']]); self::notifyPlayer($playerId, 'cardDrawnPrivate', '', ['card_id' => $cardId, 'card_name' => $cardName]);
after: class Notifications { static function cardDrawn(Game $game, int $playerId, int $cardId, string $cardName): void { $game->notifyAllPlayers('cardDrawn', clienttranslate('${player_name} draws a card'), ['player_id' => $playerId]); $game->notifyPlayer($playerId, 'cardDrawnPrivate', '', ['card_id' => $cardId, 'card_name' => $cardName]); } static function refreshUI(Game $game, array $publicState): void { $game->notifyAllPlayers('refreshUI', '', $publicState); } static function refreshHand(Game $game, int $playerId, array $privateState): void { $game->notifyPlayer($playerId, 'refreshHand', '', $privateState); } static function clearTurn(Game $game): void { $game->notifyAllPlayers('clearTurn', '', []); } }
explanation: All notifications are sent through a single centralized class (NOTF-001). Each event has exactly one static method (NOTF-003). The card draw uses the dual pattern: a public notification (all players see that a card was drawn) and a private notification (only the drawing player sees which card) following NOTF-008. updateArgs auto-resolves player IDs to names and handles i18n (NOTF-004). User-visible strings are wrapped in clienttranslate (NOTF-014). refreshUI and refreshHand are the canonical reconnect pair (NOTF-005, NOTF-006). clearTurn cleans up after undo (NOTF-007). Every notification carries absolute values, never deltas (NOTF-012). Notifications are sent after all mutations complete (NOTF-011).
common_mistakes: Notifying directly with notifyAllPlayers outside the Notifications class
Including hidden card data in the public notification payload (leaks information)
Omitting updateArgs and leaving raw player IDs in notification payloads
Using delta values instead of absolute state in notification payloads
Failing to wrap user-visible strings in clienttranslate

annotations.reason: All notifications centralized in one class.
One static method per notification type.
Public notification: all players see a card was drawn.
Private notification: only drawing player sees which card.
clearTurn resets client UI after undo.
